title_zh: 试听后更换间歇失灵的音箱

scenario.label_zh: 选择故障音箱的替代品
scenario.goal_zh: 说明音箱故障，试听同价替代型号后确认更换

context_zh: 顾客帕维尔带着购买凭证退换一台音箱，店员伊玛现场试听同价替代型号。
author: author-phase06-a

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: This speaker makes an odd crackling sound when I use it on battery power.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: Does it happen when the cable is connected too?

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: No, it works perfectly then. But I bought it to use away from a socket.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: Obviously, it needs to work on its battery as well. Your receipt is here, so we can arrange an exchange.

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: I need a reliable connection for my dance class. Could we try the other model before I choose?

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: Certainly. It is the same price. I have unplugged it now; connect your phone and play a track.

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: The music is clear. I have walked across the shop, and it has not cut out or crackled.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: Would you like this model instead, then?

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: Yes, please. This is the one I want.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: All right. I have recorded the exchange. Here is your replacement and the updated receipt.
